items.title: E-Verify ICA v32 Upgrade Required by March 31, 2027 for Web Services Integrations
items.summary: On September 22, 2026, E-Verify published Interface Control Agreement (ICA) Version 32. Developers using E-Verify web services integration must complete software integration and acceptance testing for ICA v32 by March 31, 2027 or they will lose API access. The requirement applies only to organizations with direct E-Verify web services (API) integration — not to employers who use E-Verify manually or through third-party HR/I-9 systems. ICA v32 and change log are available in the Resources section of E-Verify staging and production accounts. Technical questions: e-verify-webservices@uscis.dhs.gov.

items.title: USCIS Premium Processing Timeframe Proposal Under White House Review
items.summary: DHS-USCIS sent a proposed rule titled 'Amending the Premium Processing Timeframe' (RIN 1615-AD25) to OIRA on October 13, 2026. As of November 6, 2026, the proposal is pending White House review and has not been published in the Federal Register. No public text, comment deadline, or effective date exists. Current periods remain: 15 business days for O-1 and H-1B; 15 business days for EB-1A/EB-1B I-140; 45 business days for EB-1C and NIW I-140.

items.title: DHS/ICE Practical Training Rulemaking on Regulatory Agenda — NPRM Target February 2027
items.summary: RIN 1653-AA97 appears on the DHS/ICE regulatory agenda at the proposed-rule stage with a February 2027 NPRM target date. An agenda target is a planning estimate, not a binding deadline or adopted text. No proposed rule has been published in the Federal Register. It does not establish that OPT will end, be shortened, or change in any specific way.
